# Core Systems Asset Factory (CSAF) catalogue

> Core Systems Asset Factory (CSAF) is a game development studio. It sells game assets, engine tools and games: tilesets, sprite packs, sound effect packs, game music, voice packs, UI kits, RPG Maker MZ plugins, GameMaker assets, Godot 4 addons, Unity and Unreal Engine editor tools, and games for desktop and the browser. Every product is made with AI and its listing says so. The store is https://csaf.itch.io/ and this site is the studio's own catalogue of 619 products: one plain page per product, each linking to its store page. No prices are printed here; prices are on the store pages.

Generated from the live store pages, last read 2026-10-23T07:05:44.371Z. Site: https://onefreeman1337.github.io/csaf-releases/

## Tilesets

Tileset packs for 2D games. Tile size, layout and engine importers are stated on each store page. 85 products.
